name: escalate_to_human
trigger: The caller asks a price that is not in your prompt, complains about glasses already made, makes a wholesale, factory or partnership enquiry, or simply asks to be called back. Do NOT start this procedure for a question about what products the shops carry, or whether something is in stock, and do NOT start it for a question about the caller's own order - their glasses, lenses or anything else made for them, whether it is ready or what stage it is at. Your system prompt handles those two by putting the caller through to a colleague. Start this procedure for one of those only once the branch is closed, or a transfer has failed, and the caller has accepted a callback.

HOLDING LINE: you may say a short natural holding phrase in the caller's language as the call goes out, or say nothing at all - silence is better than repetition. If you do speak, keep it to a few words and NEVER reuse a phrase you have already used earlier in this call. No filler sounds. Romanian options: Notez acum. / Imediat. Hungarian options: Feljegyzem. / Máris. ABOUT THE PHONE NUMBER: do NOT ask the caller for one and do NOT read one back. If a number was dictated and confirmed earlier in this call, leave phone and phone_confirmed out of the call entirely - it is reused automatically. Only if the tool answers phone_missing do you ask for a number: ask for it, read it back digit by digit in its own turn, wait for the caller's yes, and then call the tool again with phone and phone_confirmed true. Write summary as one or two plain sentences a colleague can act on, in the language of the call, written for a colleague and not for the caller; include the branch when you know it and any doctor, date or time mentioned, and every unknown question the caller asked in this call. Set language to the language of this call. THEN speak the outcome in the caller's language: if success is true or duplicate is true, confirm in ONE short sentence that the request has been passed on and a colleague will call them back - do not repeat the promise you already made at the start of this flow. Never promise a specific callback time or person, and never invent a reference or ticket number - if they ask for one, say a colleague will confirm the details when they call. If success is not true, NEVER say the request was passed on. If the result is missing_fields: ask only for the details it lists, wait for the answer, and call evolvo_log_request once more with everything - confirm only after a success. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never retry it more than once, and NEVER end the call because of it - say in one sentence that a colleague will call them back, give them the branch's direct phone number and opening hours from your knowledge base, and carry on normally.
